subject: Field pilot proposal — lightweight OTLP adapters for Datadog / MetricOps co-sell
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <priya@datadog.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai; marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: alex@metricops.io
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Field pilot idea — lightweight OTLP adapters + MetricOps

Sean / Marissa,

Great to meet last week at Observability Summit — thanks for the demo. Datadog wants to run a joint field pilot with Redwood and MetricOps to validate a low-friction OTLP adapter that routes traces/metrics to Datadog with minimal customer changes. Goal is to: reduce integration time (target < 2 days for POC), demonstrate latency/cost improvements with Redwood prefix caching, and create a co-sell case for our sales teams.

Proposed high-level MA P:
- Pilot scope: 3 customers (one SaaS, one fintech, one logistics) across US region
- Success metrics: POC ingest within 48 hours, end-to-end latency <100ms median for traces, <20% CPU uplift on customer's side
- Timeline: kickoff week of Jan 31, 4-week pilot per customer

We have MetricOps on the thread to help with lightweight adapter packaging and field enablement. Can Redwood provide a short playbook and a PoC build we can bundle into our co-sell materials? If so, we can fast-track a joint SOW and sales enablement.

I attached a one-page pilot summary (inline) and a suggested SOW template. Happy to jump on a 30-min sync this week.

Attachments: pilot_summary_datadog.pdf (pdf), suggested_SOW_template.docx (docx)

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Partner Sales, Observability Integrations — Datadog
pri...datadog.com | +1 415-555-0192
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Priya Sharma <priya@datadog.com>; Alex Byrne <alex@metricops.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai; ben_carter@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Field pilot idea — lightweight OTLP adapters + MetricOps

Priya — thanks, this looks actionable. We're keen to run this with Datadog + MetricOps. High level reply: yes on the scope and metrics, we can ship a field-friendly adapter and a short playbook to reduce onboarding time.

Quick asks from our side to make the pilot smooth:
- One contract/SOW that has simple liability and data flow language (we can tolerate Datadog ingest; Redwood will not persist customer logs beyond the pilot)
- A shared runbook with contact routing for incidents (we'll provide a runbook template)
- Access requirements for customer test accounts (API keys, environment details)

I'm attaching a first-draft playbook (field_playbook_v0.3.xlsx) that lays out roles, timelines, and a checklist for POC readiness. Marissa — can you take point on playbook -> final? Ben, can you assess the PoC adapter effort (code + test harness) and estimate engineering days? Laura, please prepare a short commercial note for SOW items we should not accept.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
sean.g@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0122

Folks — quick internal runbook draft and owners (based on Sean's ask):

1) Playbook finalization (owner: marissa_cole) — due Jan 26
   - Incorporate Datadog success metrics and MetricOps packaging notes
   - Deliverable: field_playbook_v1.xlsx (final)

2) Engineering PoC (owner: ben_carter) — estimate required by Jan 24
   - Task: produce redwood_adapter_proof_of_concept.zip with example Kubernetes helm chart and docker image tag
   - Test harness: small load generator + Datadog API keys to verify telemetry routing

3) Legal / SOW review (owner: laura_bennett) — first pass by Jan 22
   - Flag any unusual indemnity, data retention, or export controls

4) Field enablement & co-sell assets (owner: sean_gallagher) — start Jan 27
   - One-pager, slide deck, and sales play steps for co-sell motion

Notes: we'll aim for a joint kickoff call Jan 31. Marissa — I'll sync with MetricOps on packaging constraints. Ben — if we need a small budget for a hosted test account, flag it and I'll route through Priya.

Marissa
Sr. Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.c@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@datadog.com>; Alex Byrne <alex@metricops.io>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai; marissa_cole@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 23 Jan 2027 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Field pilot idea — lightweight OTLP adapters + MetricOps

Priya / Alex — quick technical summary from PoC scope perspective (Ben, Redwood infra):

- Work items (rough):
  * Build adapter shim that accepts OTLP over HTTP/gRPC and forwards to Datadog intake with minimal transformation
  * Add Redwood prefix/KV caching hook to reduce repeated export cost (opt-in via config)
  * Provide sample helm chart + quickstart (we'll include a docker image tag in zip)

- Estimated effort: 6 dev days + 2 QA days for a minimal PoC (we can compress with an engineer on both sides)

- Attachments: redwood_adapter_proof_of_concept.zip (contains sample chart, Dockerfile, small loadgen, README and test vectors)

- Security note: for pilot we suggest scoped API keys and rate limits; no customer PII should be routed via the PoC harness. We'll provide an env var-based secrets guide.

Onwards to SOW/ops.

Ben Carter
Principal Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.c@redwood.ai
